description: This source file defines a thread-safe counter class named 'Counter' used for high throughput counting in concurrent environments. It extends an internal striped mechanism for concurrency control and provides methods for counting, incrementing, and adding values atomically.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A thread-safe counter suitable for high throughput counting across many concurrent threads, based on the LongAdder class.

methods.name: Counter
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Counter instance with an initial sum of zero.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Computes the current total count by summing the base value and all cell values.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified long value to the counter atomically.
